name: ADEM SSO reports, all dates (SSOs_ALL_OB_ID MapServer layer 0)
waters_covered: statewide; receiving water free text (rec_stream, e.g. "Storm Drain(Tanyard Branch)")
access_detail: https://gis.adem.alabama.gov/arcgis/rest/services/SSOs_ALL_OB_ID/MapServer/0/query?where=...&outFields=*&f=json. Public, no key. 14,750 rows on 2026-11-03, first date_sso_began 2012-05-11, latest 2026-11-03 13:03 (the same day; minutes of latency). maxRecordCount 2000; resultOffset paging fails ("Failed to execute query"), so page by object_id ranges; outStatistics fail. Coordinates in lat/long fields and as point geometry (NAD83 UTM 16N, wkid 26916). Samples raw/sso-history-sample.json, raw/sso-history-recent.json.

sample_record.LOCATION_OF_DISCHARGE: north side of Pursley at end of rd

cannot_fill: reported_at (received_date is only in the live layer)
timezone (dates look like local wall time stored as UTC epoch: 01:03 pm local began = 13:03 epoch)
cadence: Continuous; the reporter files the 24-hour notice in AEPACS and it appears at once. Rule deadline: within 24 hours of becoming aware; 5-day follow-up.
license: No licence or terms shown on the service or the map page.
legal_basis: ADEM Admin. Code r. 335-6-6-.12(l)6.(v) (immediate notification); r. 335-6-6-.02(hh) (notifiable SSO)
status_reason: Read hourly by pipeline/ingest/al_adem_sso.py (the last 60 days and ongoing reports; the whole layer every 20 hours): 14,758 reports on 2026-11-07 (2012-05-11 to 2026-11-06; 1,106 to 2,293 a year since 2017; 1,008 in 2026 to date), 319 permits, 9 marked ongoing; every report has a point; the receiving-water words name a water on 9,627, say none was reached on 4,111 and name only a storm drain or ditch or nothing on 1,020.
notes: est_volume is a string, sometimes truncated (e.g. "<=1,0", "10,000 < gall"): take the full range from the live layer or the AEPACS PDF. Several older test services (SSO_ALL_AEPACS, SSO_ALL_Dates_ALT frozen at 9,830 rows to 2022-09-30) exist on the same server; use SSOs_ALL_OB_ID.

name: ADEM Sanitary Sewer Overflow Map (SSO_Service MapServer layer 0, current SSOs)
access_detail: https://gis.adem.alabama.gov/arcgis/rest/services/SSO_Service/MapServer/0/query?where=1%3D1&outFields=*&f=json. 27 rows on 2026-11-03. Per ADEM, SSOs "are displayed on the map for 10 days after the SSO has ceased"; ongoing ones stay (one from 2018 still shows). Popup links to eFile per permit. Sample raw/sso-sample.json, raw/sso-all27.json.
cadence: Minutes (row received 2026-11-03 1:40 PM present the same afternoon)
history: rolling: ongoing plus 10 days after end
legal_basis: ADEM Admin. Code r. 335-6-6-.12(l)6.(v) (immediate notification); r. 335-6-6-.02(hh) (notifiable SSO)
status_reason: Read with the history layer by pipeline/ingest/al_adem_sso.py: 31 reports on 2026-11-07; gives ADEM's received time, the report type, the cause and the volume range in full (the history layer cuts it at 15 characters).

name: ADEM eFile SSO report PDFs (per permit)
access_detail: ASP.NET results page per permit and DocType=SSO; lists AEPACS-signed PDFs (e.g. "8299 AL0050237 081 10-30-2026 SSO AEPACS SSO-00214479.1.pdf"); 107 SSO documents for Auburn. Each PDF is the full AEPACS form: start/stop, wet weather, volume range or value, source (lift station, manhole), counties, lat/long, address, receiving water, cause, and whether the 24-hour notice was on time.
cannot_fill: nothing beyond the layers except cause/wet-weather detail
legal_basis: ADEM Admin. Code r. 335-6-6-.12(l)6.(v) (immediate notification); r. 335-6-6-.02(hh) (notifiable SSO)
status_reason: Citation target for each event (the signed form); not needed for ingest.

name: ADEM opt-in SSO email notification (by county)
access_detail: Launched May 2017 at the request of Waterkeepers Alabama and Alabama Rivers Alliance; subscribers tick "Sanitary Sewer Overflows" and choose counties (per Coosa Riverkeeper instructions). Sign-up page not re-fetched.
status_reason: The ArcGIS layer carries the same events; owner may subscribe as a cross-check.

name: ADEM Admin. Code r. 335-6-6-.12(l)6.(v) Immediate notification
access_detail: Text quoted from the 2017 petition (raw/petition-2017-excerpt.txt) and the AEPACS SSO form instructions (raw/aepacs-sso-example.pdf).
status_reason: Legal basis for the public duty and the 24-hour/5-day clock.

name: Petition to amend r. 335-6-6-.12 (Alabama Rivers Alliance and eight riverkeepers, March 2017)
operator: Alabama Rivers Alliance and riverkeeper groups
access_detail: Asked for a minimum standard: notice within hours, web posting, media notice and an opt-in alert list. The Environmental Management Commission denied a 2018 follow-up petition (12-hour window) per Sierra Club Alabama; ADEM responded with the email list and the map.

name: ADEM / ADPH Coastal Alabama Beach Monitoring (BeachMonitoring_New MapServer layer 15)
operator: Alabama Department of Environmental Management with Alabama Department of Public Health
waters_covered: 25 to 30 coastal stations (Gulf of Mexico, Mobile Bay, Perdido Bay, Dog and Fowl rivers)
access_detail: .../BeachMonitoring_New/MapServer/15/query?where=1%3D1&outFields=*&f=json. 30 stations; fields ID (BEACON id e.g. AL769933), Descriptio, WaterbodyN, Latitude, Longitude, URL (results PDF), Date (last sample, "11/02/26"), Advisory (small integer; all 11 on 2026-11-03; legend Green/Yellow/Red, so code meaning to confirm). Sample raw/beach-sample.json.
cadence: Weekly in season (May to October), less often off season
history: current state only; PDFs per site
status_reason: Read hourly by pipeline/ingest/al_adem_beaches.py: 25 stations on 2026-11-07, all with advisory code 11; ADEM does not publish the codes' meaning, so 11 is read as no advisory and any other code opens a beach advisory (the side of caution).
notes: The legend has a "Green" class; the site must not reuse that colour.

name: ADEM Outfall_Map_Data and MunicipalOutfalls MapServers
access_detail: Outfall_Map_Data layer 0 "Discharge Types" 502 rows; MunicipalOutfalls2 layer 16 "Municipal Outfalls". Not sampled (pagination not supported error on a default query).
status_reason: Possibly better outfall points than ICIS; compare later.

name: Mobile Baykeeper SWIM bacteria monitoring (Swim Guide affiliate)
waters_covered: 16 sites in Mobile and Baldwin counties
access_detail: Weekly April 1 to September 30, monthly otherwise; results to Swim Guide; season PDFs per site.
status_reason: Swim Guide data access is by agreement.

name: Mobile Area Water and Sewer System overflow news posts
operator: Mobile Area Water and Sewer System
waters_covered: Mobile area creeks (Dog River, Halls Mill Creek, Eslava Creek)
access_detail: Each overflow gets a news post ("wastewater overflow 9830 howells ferry rd", "preliminary advisory"); WordPress site, an RSS feed is likely but not fetched.
status_reason: Duplicates the ADEM layer; useful for advice text.

name: Jefferson County Environmental Services Everbridge overflow alerts
operator: Jefferson County Commission, Environmental Services Department
waters_covered: Birmingham area (Cahaba, Valley, Village, Five Mile creeks)
access_detail: Everbridge opt-in alerts since March 2021 (first in Alabama, per Bham Now); GovDelivery bulletins for no-contact advisories.
status_reason: Owner sign-up only; ADEM layer carries the events.

name: EPA SOBE (eRule) extract, Alabama rows
access_detail: 0 Alabama rows on 2026-11-03: Alabama permittees report in AEPACS, not NeT-SewerOverflow.

name: Alabama freshwater cyanobacteria advisories
access_detail: No state freshwater HAB advisory program found (NRDC scorecard: coastal bacteria only, no cyanotoxin sampling). Not searched on adph.org in depth.
